_comment: Pre-encode the CONSTRUCTED dataset to 4ch VAE latents (run pre_encode_4ch.py with the unwrapped Stage-1 VAE). Two sources: (a) synthesized FOA with captions from refine_caption.py ({id, foa_path, caption}); (b) 60k REAL Spatial LibriSpeech FOA used directly, with its original real-geometry prompts (sls_prompts.jsonl). max_files=60000 matches the VAE config (same deterministic SLS subset). NOTE: refine_caption.py auto-merges its multi-GPU shards (captions.gpuN.jsonl) into captions.jsonl on completion; only if a run was interrupted, merge by hand with: cat captions.gpu*.jsonl >> captions.jsonl
